description_en: Registers a gateway by calling CreateGateway
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan create-gateway --gw-eui 0000000000000000 --pin-code 000000 --name vmee --freq-band-plan-group-id 123 --communication-mode HALF_DUPLEX --city '杭州' --district '滨江区' --address '详细地址' --gis-coordinate-system GCJ_02 --longitude 123.45678 --latitude 23.45678 --address-code 123 --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGateway

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
parameters.name: gw_eui

parameters.help_en: The PinCode of the gateway, which is used to verify that the registrant owns the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 网关PinCode，用于确保录入者拥有该网关
parameters.name: pin_code

parameters.help_en:
The custom gateway name.

Only Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_) are supported.

The name must start with a Chinese character, letter, or digit.

The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as one character
parameters.help_zh:
自定义网关名称。

仅支持中文汉字、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）。

必须以中文汉字、英文字母或数字开头。

长度不超过30个字符，不少于4个字符（一个中文汉字算一个字符）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The custom description of the gateway. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as one character
parameters.help_zh: 自定义网关描述信息，长度不超过100个字符（一个中文汉字算一个字符）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The frequency band ID of the gateway
parameters.name: freq_band_plan_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The communication mode of the gateway. Valid values:

FULL_DUPLEX: full-duplex.

HALF_DUPLEX: half-duplex
parameters.help_zh:
网关通信模式。取值：

FULL_DUPLEX：全双工。

HALF_DUPLEX：半双工
parameters.name: communication_mode

parameters.help_en: The name of the city where the gateway is located
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en: The name of the district where the gateway is located
parameters.name: district

parameters.help_en: The detailed address where the gateway is located
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The coordinate system used for the longitude and latitude of the gateway. Valid values: WGS_84 and GCJ_02
parameters.help_zh: 网关经纬度所采用的坐标系统，可取值为WGS_84, GCJ_02
parameters.name: gis_coordinate_system

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the gateway is located, as defined by `http://lbs.amap.com/api/javascript-api/download`
parameters.name: address_code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
